_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own or lease very few of our lodging properties (less than one percent of our system)'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties under more than 30 brand names'; 'As of year-end 2024, our system included 9,361 properties (1,706,331 rooms) in 144 countries and territories'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests'; 'Our hotel brands and other lodging offerings generally compete with regional, national, and international chains that operate lodging properties or franchise their brands, lodging properties that are not affiliated with a chain, and online platforms that allow travelers to book short-term rentals of homes and apartments'; 'Economic and other global, national, and regional conditions and events have in the past impacted, and could in the future impact, our business, financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of Internet travel intermediaries to book hotel reservations could adversely impact our business' (its own FY2024 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own or lease very few of our lodging properties (less than one percent of our system)'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties under more than 30 brand names'; 'As of year-end 2024, our system included 9,361 properties (1,706,331 rooms) in 144 countries and territories'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests'; 'Our hotel brands and other lodging offerings generally compete with regional, national, and international chains that operate lodging properties or franchise their brands, lodging properties that are not affiliated with a chain, and online platforms that allow travelers to book short-term rentals of homes and apartments'; 'Economic and other global, national, and regional conditions and events have in the past impacted, and could in the future impact, our business, financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of Internet travel intermediaries to book hotel reservations could adversely impact our business' (its own FY2024 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.57x; +31% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.19; conservative 2yr -3%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -29.4%/yr (worst year FY15-FY24 ex-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.2%/yr (Q3 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.4%/yr (FY15-FY24 ex-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +74.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24 ex-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2025-08-22) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.57x (64.2% downside to Bear $98 / +41.0% upside to Bull $386) | Adj composite 2.16 vs market 2.35: gap -0.19 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +31% above the EPP floor $209 (21x FY25E $9.96) | Conservative 2-yr case: -3.0% total (-1.5%/yr) | At 27.5x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $362 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; North American RevPAR +1.6% in Q2 2025, forward fee revenue +2.1-3.27% (Q3 2025 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
